name: Injoku Shinryou Club
source:
There is a shinryou club at the school. Most students know it exists, but they do not know what they are doing. Tsubaki has a close male friend. She is in love with him, but she does not know what he really thinks about her. One day, she is invited to a party hosted by the shinryou club. Yes, it is just the beginning of the tragedy.... When she regains her consciousness, she finds herself being surrounded by male students. She does not know what is going on, but....

[From Erogeshop]
translation:
学校里有一个Shinryou俱乐部。大多数学生知道它的存在，但他们不知道自己在做什么。椿有一个亲密的男性朋友。她爱着他，但她不知道他对她的真实想法。有一天，她被邀请参加由Shinryyou俱乐部举办的一场聚会。是的，这只是悲剧的开始……当她恢复意识时，发现自己被男学生包围了。她不知道发生了什么，但是……

[来自Erogeshop]
